# Republic Polytechnic

> > Republic Polytechnic is a leading Singapore polytechnic institution offering 40+ diploma courses with a learner-centric approach centered on the #GreaterMe paradigm.

RP serves students through comprehensive education programs, personalized learning pathways, and community engagement opportunities. The institution emphasizes Design Thinking methodologies, industry partnerships, and lifelong learning to prepare graduates for evolving career landscapes.

## Key Topics

- Republic Polytechnic (RP)
- Diploma Programs
- Design Thinking
- RP 360° Virtual Tour
- Designing Your Life/Learning/Impact
- #GreaterMe Journey
- Orientation Programme
- Student Development
- Enrolment & Admissions
- Odyssey Plans
- Campus Life
- Industry Partnerships
- Lifelong Learning (RP Academy ACE)
- ELR2B2 Entry Requirements
- Community Engagement

## Admissions & Enrolment

- [Admissions](https://www.rp.edu.sg/admissions): Admissions hub with intake numbers, ELR2B2 ranges, and entry requirements.
- [Enrolment](https://www.rp.edu.sg/admissions/enrolment): Step-by-step enrolment guide for new RP students with PDPA compliance.
- [Orientation Programme](https://www.rp.edu.sg/op): Orientation Programme 2026 with #GreaterMe Journey and student onboarding.

## Education & Programmes

- [Diploma Courses](https://www.rp.edu.sg/education/diplomas): Comprehensive listing of 40+ diploma courses across four schools.
- [Education](https://www.rp.edu.sg/education): Overview of diploma courses, programs, and pathways to further studies.
- [Designing Your Learning](https://www.rp.edu.sg/designing-your-learning): Customizable learning pathways including broad-based and expertise programs.
- [Designing Your Life](https://www.rp.edu.sg/designing-your-life): Design Thinking framework for career planning using Odyssey Plans.
- [Designing Your Impact](https://www.rp.edu.sg/designing-your-impact): Community engagement and personal growth through white-space learning.

## Student Life & Support

- [Student Life](https://www.rp.edu.sg/student): Campus guides, support services, and learning opportunities for students.
- [Laptop Support and Setup](https://www.rp.edu.sg/student/academic-matters/laptop-support): Guide for laptop purchase, setup, and IT support via SNApp and POLITEMall.
- [RP 360°](https://www.rp.edu.sg/rp360): Interactive 360° virtual campus tour showcasing RP facilities.

## Continuing Education & Industry

- [Lifelong Learning](https://www.rp.edu.sg/lifelong-learning): RP Academy for Continuing Education (ACE) for upskilling and reskilling.
- [Industry](https://www.rp.edu.sg/industry): Industry partnerships, recruitment, and talent development initiatives.

## About & News

- [Home](https://www.rp.edu.sg): RP homepage showcasing student life, campus tours, and key programs like RP 360°.
- [About us](https://www.rp.edu.sg/about-us): Institution overview covering educational excellence and Greater Me paradigm.
- [News](https://www.rp.edu.sg/news): News hub featuring student stories, media releases, and institutional updates.
- [Contact us](https://www.rp.edu.sg/about-us/contact-us): Contact information and Ask RP live chat for enquiries.
